steps.text: A pendulum is a weight that swings back and forth at a steady rate — perfect for keeping time. Let's set one going.
Watch how regular it is — one full swing (there and back) always takes the same time. That steady rhythm is why pendulums run clocks.
The time for one complete swing is called the time period. Because it stays the same, a pendulum can measure time reliably.

coach.mission: Swing the pendulum and see how steady its rhythm is.
whenStuck: Tap “Start” and watch the pendulum swing.
Time one full swing, then another — they match.
whenWrong: Each full swing takes the same time — that steady beat is the point.
One complete back-and-forth swing is the time period.
whenCorrect: Right — the pendulum swings at a steady, regular rate.
Good — a constant time period is what makes it a timekeeper.
coach.done: You've seen a pendulum's steady swing. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
